name: Send a template to your test list
description: Send a template to your test list. Send a test email of the specified transactional template to one or more recipients. Provide an array of email addresses in the `emailTo` field; if left empty, the test mail is sent to your entire test list. You can send a maximum of 50 test emails per day, and all provided email addresses must be valid.

emailTo.description: List of the email addresses of the recipients whom you wish to send the test mail. _If left empty, the test mail will be sent to your entire test list. You can not send more than 50 test emails per day_.

execution.auth: API key in the api-key header, or OAuth 2.0. Not included here.

side_effects: Sends real messages to recipients and consumes plan quota. Cannot be undone.
